decisions.reason: As the flagship organic sliced salami line central to the firm's organic expansion and close to its core processes, it is cheap to maintain and has shown no negative signal, so the option stays open.

The premium sharing salami line runs on established curing capabilities at low holding cost, and two years of evidence give no clear sign that its value will not be realized, so keeping it remains justified.

The organic Fleischwurst launched only in 2024 builds on traditional processing know-how, its market value is still highly uncertain, and keeping it costs little, so abandoning it now would be premature.

The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line is new and fits the organic and poultry direction, but the firm already withdrew organic poultry snacks, so some risk remains while too little evidence has resolved to justify dropping it.
The organic herb-coated salami is close to the core offer and cheap to keep, but it overlaps with several other salami options, so it stays as a low-cost option until results reveal its value.
